# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Student at the Academy

## Appearance

Hugh Carrow is described as a young man of noble bearing with light-colored hair and refined features typical of high-ranking Academy students. He often dresses in high-quality student robes and maintains a composed, if somewhat arrogant, posture.

## Personality

Hugh is prideful, ambitious, and deeply conscious of social standing and political advantage. He displays a cold, calculating demeanor toward those he considers inferior, though he can maintain a veneer of polite nobility when necessary. His desperation to prove himself and secure influence drives him to make dangerous alliances.

## Traits

- Ambitious
- Arrogant
- Calculating

## Abilities

- Competent in foundational magical arts taught at the Academy

## Goals

- Advance his standing and power within the Academy's factional heirarchy

## History

Hugh Carrow attends the Academy as a promising student associated with elite factions. Throughout his time at the institution, he involves himself in academic rivalry and political scheming to elevate his position. His involvement in covert plots brings him into conflict with opposing student groups and authorities. Ultimately, his dangerous machinations culminate in a fatal confrontation during the escalating crises within the Academy.

## Background by volume

- Hails from a prominent family and gained admission to the Academy under high expectations

## Affiliations

- The Academy — Student
